intro: Ivory Coast is the world's largest cocoa producer, growing about 40% of the world's supply.

chapters.title: Cocoa and more
text: Cocoa, cashews, rubber, palm oil and coffee are big exports. Most cocoa is grown on small family farms, and child labour remains a concern.
Oil and gas discoveries offshore are boosting the economy.

chapters.title: Growth
text: The economy has been one of the fastest-growing in Africa since 2012.
